verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Chargebee records usage events for usage-based billing and lets you build subscriptions from plans, addons, charges and prices, including AI-drafted catalogs from a pricing page. That implies hybrid subscription-plus-usage pricing without custom code, but none of the specific pricing models in the story are named. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of tiered, volume, graduated and per-unit pricing models, prepaid credits, commitments/minimums, overage handling, no-code configuration of these models, and independent corroboration.
